L19@P0: Remote participation by the public is available through Zoom. To access the meeting remotely: Join from a PC,
L20@P0: Mac, iPad, iPhone, or Android device: Please use this URL: https://cityofberkeleyinfo.zoomgov.com/j/1607533030. If you do not wish for your name to appear on the screen, then use the drop
L21@P0: down menu and click on "rename" to rename yourself to be anonymous. To request to speak, use the “raise
L22@P0: hand” icon by rolling over the bottom of the screen. To join by phone: Dial 1-669-254-5252 or 1-833-568-8864

L27@P0: To submit a written communication for the City Council’s consideration and inclusion in the public record, email
L28@P0: council@berkeleyca.gov.

L41@P1: Land Acknowledgement Statement: The City of Berkeley recognizes that the community we
L42@P1: live in was built on the territory of xučyun (Huchiun (Hooch-yoon)), the ancestral and unceded land of the
L43@P1: Chochenyo (Cho-chen-yo)-speaking Ohlone (Oh-low-nee) people, the ancestors and descendants of the
L44@P1: sovereign Verona Band of Alameda County. This land was and continues to be of great importance to all
L45@P1: of the Ohlone Tribes and descendants of the Verona Band. As we begin our meeting tonight, we
L46@P1: acknowledge and honor the original inhabitants of Berkeley, the documented 5,000-year history of a
L47@P1: vibrant community at the West Berkeley Shellmound, and the Ohlone people who continue to reside in
L48@P1: the East Bay. We recognize that Berkeley’s residents have and continue to benefit from the use and
L49@P1: occupation of this unceded stolen land since the City of Berkeley’s incorporation in 1878. As stewards of
L50@P1: the laws regulating the City of Berkeley, it is not only vital that we recognize the history of this land, but
L51@P1: also recognize that the Ohlone people are present members of Berkeley and other East Bay communities
L52@P1: today. The City of Berkeley will continue to build relationships with the Lisjan Tribe and to create
L53@P1: meaningful actions that uphold the intention of this land acknowledgement.
L54@P1: Report from Closed Session
L55@P1: The City Council met in closed session on July 10, 2023, pursuant to Government Code Sections
L56@P1: 54956.9(a) and 54956.9(d)(1) and approved a settlement in the matter of Smith v. City of Berkeley,
L57@P1: Alameda County Superior Court Case No. 22CV012424, in the amount of $240,000 in exchange for a
L58@P1: release of all claims against the City.
L59@P1: Ceremonial Matters:
